# SequreByte

> SequreByte is a vulnerability management and compliance-readiness platform. It scans web apps (including behind a login), dependencies and SBOMs, AWS and Azure cloud posture, TLS certificates, external attack surface, ports and signatures, and firewall rulesets, then maps findings onto ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27001:2013, SOC 2 and the RBI Cyber Security Framework and keeps dated evidence. It imports reports from Nessus, OpenVAS and SonarQube.

SequreByte does not issue SOC 2 reports or ISO 27001 certificates; those come from independent auditors and accredited certification bodies.
